parameters.query: SELECT p.id AS "personId", p."canonicalName" AS name, p.city, COALESCE(array_agg(s.name ORDER BY s.name) FILTER (WHERE s.name IS NOT NULL), '{}') AS skills FROM "Person" p LEFT JOIN "PersonSkill" ps ON ps."personId" = p.id LEFT JOIN "Skill" s ON s.id = ps."skillId" LEFT JOIN "SkillClassification" sc ON sc."personId" = p.id AND sc.source = 'n8n' WHERE sc.id IS NULL GROUP BY p.id, p."canonicalName", p.city ORDER BY p."canonicalName"

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'gemini-3.6-flash', temperature: 0, max_tokens: 8000, response_format: { type: 'json_object' }, messages: [ { role: 'system', content: 'You are a recruiter skill classifier for a gig-work platform. For each candidate, categorize their skills into exactly one category: engineering, data, design, operations, sales, support, management, or other. Respond ONLY with a JSON object of the form {"candidates": [{"id": number, "category": string, "confidence": number, "reason": string}]} where id is the candidate id you received, confidence is a number between 0 and 1, and reason is one short sentence.' }, { role: 'user', content: 'Classify these candidates: ' + JSON.stringify($input.all().map(i => ({ id: i.json.personId, name: i.json.name, city: i.json.city, skills: i.json.skills }))) } ] }) }}

parameters.query: INSERT INTO "SkillClassification" ("personId", category, confidence, reason, source, "createdAt") VALUES ({{ $json.personId }}, '{{ $json.category }}', {{ $json.confidence }}, '{{ $json.reason }}', 'n8n', NOW()) ON CONFLICT ("personId", "source") DO UPDATE SET category = EXCLUDED.category, confidence = EXCLUDED.confidence, reason = EXCLUDED.reason
